title: MTSA: Multi-turn Safety Alignment for LLMs through Multi-round Red-teaming
reasoning: The paper focuses on safety alignment for Large Language Models against adversarial jailbreak attacks in multi-turn dialogues. While it mentions 'ethical safeguards' as part of a model's existing safety mechanisms, the core of the paper is technical safety alignment against harmful behaviors (like bomb-making instructions) and does not evaluate religion, faith, or specific ethical/moral systems.
